payload.title: Publish decision-model accountability article to develop
payload.description:
Publish the newsroom draft “Who Is Responsible After You Deploy a Decision Model?” as Anth.us long-form content, including a 1200x630 cover image and primary-source citations. Integrate it with the existing `codex/decision-models-are-not-calculators-site` branch into `develop`.

Acceptance criteria:
- Given the approved newsroom draft, when it becomes MDX in the content submodule, then frontmatter, images, citations, and internal links are valid.
- Given the old decision-models site branch, when both changes are integrated, then `develop` contains both without overwriting unrelated work.
- Given content and site pins are changed, when checks finish, then changes are committed, validated, and pushed.
